suggested_fix: No fix required. The function re-checks i_count under inode->i_lock after the lockless pre-check, so a concurrent find_inode()/iput() cannot grab a reference between the check and setting I_FREEING. It also skips I_NEW/I_FREEING/I_WILL_FREE inodes, removes the inode from the LRU while holding i_lock, and drops s_inode_list_lock before rescheduling and disposing, then restarts the walk.
